name: Adrienne Coburn
headline: Product Partnerships at Jobber
about: Partnerships leader with 10+ years scaling ecosystems across HR Tech, MarTech, and eCommerce. I build programs and strategic alliances that drive revenue, expand markets, and unlock product innovation — from ISV and agency networks to global HCM leaders. Passionate about turning partnerships into true growth engines and creating win-win value for companies and their customers.

experiences.description: Partnerships strategy and fractional support for growing tech companies.

Led the strategic direction of partnerships, including alliances, ISV, and channel partnerships to drive revenue growth. Developed Embedded and Reseller strategies to tap into new revenue streams and markets.
Achieved revenue targets for four consecutive quarters, earning a spot in the President's Club.  
Managed a diverse team of 8, including Channel Managers, ISV Managers, and Partner Marketing.
Put in place a partner program that would allow scale and continued growth at an optimized level. Managed several partner managers and partner marketers, supporting their portfolio growth.
Refreshed and relaunched the agency partner program at Shopify to include tiers, segmentation and enablement tracks.
Worked with top agency partners and scaled the design and development channel through enablement programs and 1:1 management.
Drove continued success of the agency and service partner revenue channels by growing the team and maturing the program.
Founding partnerships professional at the organization to build the partner program and team from ground up.
Supporting business growth through innovative and strategic partnerships. Actively sourcing and developing partnerships that will take business innovation and customer satisfaction to a new level.

Pioneer the development and activation of strategies for emerging travel products. Through forward thinking customer campaigns, support the growth of brand presence and customer advocacy in the Canadian market.

Me to We is an innovative social enterprise that provides better choices for consumers through offering sustainably made products and experiences. 

As an Account Manager, my focus was on engaging prospects for Me to We travel opportunities through phone outreach & front line engagement events across North America. Daily tasks included consulting clients on how to best support their needs, and supporting them in coordinating their experience.Other responsibilities included proactively searching for new leads, analyzing and reporting data and trends, strategizing new engagement techniques and training new team members to ensure that our services exceed client expectations.

Achievements
- Exceeded yearly targets by 55% and achieved organizations highest revenue in history
- Recognized for developing front-line engagement and cold calling strategies
- Analyzed conversion statistics through Salesforce and Google Analytics to contribute to team strategy
- Deliver sales presentations to 100+ individuals across North America
- Community Manager for the Me to We Trips Fundraising Facebook page, increasing members by 150%
